page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfc9i.xlarge is a compute-oriented virtual server from the High Clock Speed family, hosted on the KVM hypervisor. The instance is powered by an x86_64 Intel Xeon 6982P-C processor operating at a clock speed of 3.4 GHz. It provides 4 dedicated vCPUs paired with 8.0 GB of RAM, establishing a 1:2 vCPU-to-memory allocation of 2.0 GB per vCPU core.

Network performance is provisioned with a baseline bandwidth of 4 Gbps. The instance provides zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses. Local storage is not included, requiring persistent file systems and operating system images to be backed by remote block storage solutions. The instance does not feature discrete GPU accelerators.

With its dedicated high-frequency processor and lean memory footprint, ecs.hfc9i.xlarge maximizes CPU resource efficiency for compute-focused architectures that do not require massive memory arrays. The platform is well suited for CPU-intensive compilation, build automation, CI/CD testing pipelines, and lightweight backend service nodes.
